owning.title: Owning teams
owning.label: Teams

hintNone.process: This process belongs to the whole instance: roles and its shares below decide who may do what.
hintNone.platform: This platform belongs to the whole instance: roles and its shares below decide who may do what.
hintNone.service: This service belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; designers, administrators and its owners change it.
hintNone.application: This application belongs to the whole instance (or to the teams of its services): everybody signed in sees it; designers, administrators and its owners change it.
hintNone.system: This system belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; designers, administrators and its owners change it.
hintNone.record: This document belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; roles and its owner decide who changes and approves it.
hintNone.credential: This entry belongs to the whole instance: roles and its owners decide who sees and changes it.
hintNone.monitor: This monitor belongs to the whole instance: roles and its shares below decide who may do what.
hintNone.dashboard: This dashboard belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; its owner and administrators change it.
hintNone.ticket: This ticket reference belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; designers, operators and its responsibles change it.
hintNone.site: This site belongs to the whole instance: roles and its shares below decide who may see and manage it, its hierarchy and its assets.
hintNone.contract: This data contract belongs to the whole instance: everybody who works in Steward sees it; operators test it, designers change it.
hintNone.platform_identity: No owning team: only administrators and its shares below may use this identity.
hintNone.supplier: This supplier belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; designers, administrators and its owners change it.
hintNone.cost_price_book: No owning team: the costs managers (administrators and designers) maintain this price book; a list book is read by everyone using Costs.
hintNone.cost_calculator: No owning team: the costs managers (administrators and designers) maintain this calculator; everyone using Costs reads it.
hintNone.device_profile: This device profile belongs to the whole instance: everyone who sees the plant registry sees it; designers and administrators change it. Owning teams keep it to their members – assets that have it still show the data they deliver.
hintNone.kpi_definition: This KPI definition belongs to the whole instance: everyone who sees the plant registry sees it; designers and administrators change it.
hintNone.data_product: This data product belongs to the whole instance: everybody who works in Steward sees it; designers and its product owners change it.
hintNone.data_object: This data object belongs to the whole instance: everybody who works in Steward sees it; designers change it.
hintNone.data_element: This element belongs to the whole instance: everybody who works in Steward sees it; designers change it.
hintNone.data_domain: This data domain belongs to the whole instance: everybody who works in Steward sees it; designers and its owners change it.

hintOwned.process: Members of these teams have their roles in the team on this process. Everyone else sees it only through its shares below; administrators always, auditors may view.
hintOwned.platform: Members of these teams have their roles in the team on this platform. Everyone else sees it only through its shares below; administrators always.
hintOwned.service: Only members of these teams see this service (designers among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.application: Only members of these teams see this application (designers among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.system: Only members of these teams see this system (designers among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.record: Only members of these teams see this document (editors and approvers among them change and approve it), besides its owner, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.credential: Only members of these teams see this entry (designers and operators among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.monitor: Members of these teams have their roles in the team on this monitor. Everyone else sees it only through its shares below; administrators always, auditors may view.
hintOwned.dashboard: Only members of these teams see this dashboard, besides its owner, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.ticket: Only members of these teams see this ticket reference (designers and operators among them change it), besides its responsibles, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.site: Only members of these teams see this site with its hierarchy and assets (designers among them manage it), besides those it is shared with, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.contract: Only members of these teams see this data contract (operators among them test it, designers change it), besides administrators and auditors. A failed test notifies them.
hintOwned.platform_identity: Members of these teams who design or operate may use this identity; everyone else only what its shares give.
hintOwned.supplier: Only members of these teams see this supplier (designers among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.cost_price_book: Designers of these teams maintain this price book; a contracted book is read only by the teams’ members, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.cost_calculator: Designers of these teams maintain this calculator; everyone using Costs reads it.
hintOwned.device_profile: Only members of these teams see this device profile (designers among them manage it), besides administrators and auditors. Others see the interfaces and data points it gives an asset they may see, without its name.
hintOwned.kpi_definition: Only members of these teams see this KPI definition (designers among them manage it), besides administrators and auditors. Its KPI instances on assets others may see keep working, without its name.
hintOwned.data_product: Only members of these teams see this data product (designers among them change it), besides its product owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.data_object: Only members of these teams see this data object (designers among them change it), besides its data owner and stewards, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.data_element: Only members of these teams see this element of the catalogue (designers among them change it), besides administrators and auditors. Data products it is part of still show it as their content.
hintOwned.data_domain: Only members of these teams see this data domain (designers among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.

owning.hintRestricted: Restricted: no owning team, and roles in the instance give nothing on it – only its shares, its owners, administrators and auditors reach it.

shares.title: Shared with
shares.loadFailed: The shares could not be loaded.

scope.instance: Scope: the whole instance – no owning teams, so everybody's roles apply, and the shares below add to them.
scope.teams: Scope: the owning teams ({{teams}}) – their members have their roles, and the shares below add exceptions.
scope.restricted: Scope: Restricted – only the shares below, owners, administrators and auditors reach this item.
scope.identity: Closed by default: only administrators, members of its owning teams who design or operate, and the entries below use this identity – and only who may use the platform as well.

shares.restrictedHint: Instance roles give nothing on this item: only its shares, owners, administrators and auditors reach it.
shares.outsideRestricted: gives access to a Restricted item
shares.impliedHint: The owner field gives these shares, and they go when the owner is removed. They do not limit who sees the item – owning teams do.
shares.impliedHintResponsible: The responsible field gives these shares, and they go when the responsible is removed. They do not limit who sees the item – owning teams do.
shares.scopeToTeams: To keep this item to some teams, set its owning teams.
shares.notYours: Only who manages this item, administrators and auditors see whom it is shared with. Why do I have access? shows your own reasons.
shares.unknown: No longer exists – this share matches nobody
shares.hidden_one: And {{count}} share with a user or team you may not see – it is kept when you save.
shares.hidden_other: And {{count}} shares with users or teams you may not see – they are kept when you save.
shares.stepUpHint: Giving access asks you to confirm it is you.
shares.custom: Custom: {{rights}} – exactly the rights of its former access-list entry. Changing the share replaces them with its level.

ownerNotSaved: The owner could not be saved
ownerNotYours: Who manages this item changes its owner.
